options.title: Comparison options
options.description: Adjust granularity, view, and which differences should be ignored.

modeDescriptions.linhas: Best for documents, lists, clauses, messages, and code blocks.
modeDescriptions.palavras: Best for short sentences and paragraphs with punctuation or term changes.
modeDescriptions.caracteres: Best for small snippets when each character matters.

ignorarCaixa.label: Ignore case
ignorarCaixa.description: Case-only differences do not count as changes.

ignorarEspacosFinais.label: Ignore trailing spaces
ignorarEspacosFinais.description: Spaces and tabs at the end of each line are ignored for comparison.

ignorarLinhasVazias.label: Ignore empty lines
ignorarLinhasVazias.description: Blank lines do not count as added or removed content.

share.title: Share
share.description: By default, the link stores only mode, view, and safe options.
share.includeContent: Include texts in the shared link
share.safe: The current link does not include pasted or typed text.
share.publicWarning: Links with texts expose both versions to anyone who receives the URL.
share.tooLong: The texts are too large for a safe link. The link will include only options.

result.title: Summary
result.description: Review the counts before copying the summary or unified diff.
result.identicalDescription: The texts are identical with the current options.
result.differentDescription: There are differences between the versions. Review the highlighted blocks below.
result.missingOriginalDescription: The original text is empty, so all revised text appears as added.
result.missingRevisedDescription: The revised text is empty, so all original text appears as removed.
result.tooLargeDescription: One text exceeds the {limit}-character limit. Use a smaller snippet to avoid browser freezes.
result.tooManyTokensDescription: There are too many tokens for this mode. Use line comparison or reduce the text.

warnings.largeInput: Input is above the safety limit.
warnings.lineEndingNormalized: CRLF or CR line endings were normalized to LF for comparison.
warnings.trailingSpacesIgnored: Trailing line spaces are being ignored.
warnings.inlineDiffSkipped: Some inline highlights were skipped to keep the page responsive.
warnings.comparisonApproximation: Comparison stopped before building an oversized matrix.

diff.title: Differences
diff.description: Highlights are plain-text approximations. Review sensitive documents, code, and legal content manually.
diff.empty: Differences will appear here after you fill both texts.

privacy.question: Is the text sent to the server?
privacy.answer: No. Comparison runs in the browser. Texts enter a link only if you explicitly enable including texts when sharing.

modes.question: What is the difference between line, word, and character comparison?
modes.answer: Lines work best for documents and lists. Words help with short paragraphs. Characters are for small snippets with very specific changes.

ignore.question: Can I ignore case, spaces, and empty lines?
ignore.answer: Yes. These options affect the equality used for comparison and can intentionally hide differences.

formats.question: Does the tool compare Word, PDF, or formatted text?
formats.answer: No. This version compares plain text pasted into the fields without preserving rich formatting.

legal.question: Does this count as a legal redline?
legal.answer: No. The result is informational and can help review, but legal documents should be checked manually.

sharing.question: Can I share an already filled comparison?
sharing.answer: Yes, but only with the include-texts option. Use it only when all recipients may read both versions.

differences.question: Why can the result differ from another comparator?
differences.answer: Each comparator uses its own tokenization, grouping, and limits. This tool prioritizes local, predictable, responsive behavior.

seo.about: The text comparator helps review two versions of plain-text content. It shows added, removed, modified, and unchanged blocks with side-by-side or unified views.
seo.howToUse: Paste the original text, paste the revised text, choose line, word, or character comparison, and review the highlights. Shared links store only options by default; include texts only when the content can be public.
